podcast.body: Released in 1997, this song achieved significant commercial success, peaking at number two in Canada and number eight on the Billboard Hot 100. Its popularity made it a prominent track on top 40 radio, and it was later covered with some success by Maroon 5. "It reached number two in Canada and got as high as number eights on the Billboard Hot 100."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
